pages.title: Hear It
pages.text: Water, fire and note blocks all hold rules. I will borrow a gentle one first: make a gem sing.$(br2)Learn assembly from a crafting table and sound from a note block. Carve an $(l)Instant Core, Self Position and Sound node$().

Put an $(l)Instant Core$() in the writing table. Add Self Position as the origin and Sound as the main action.$(br2)Select Sound and choose a familiar sound. Reference slots copy a sample without consuming it.

pages.title: Carry the Sound
pages.text: Take out the core. A complete pattern takes shape; an unfinished one can be carried away too.$(br2)$(l)Sneak-use the wand$() to open it and insert the formed core. Bring a charged container, then try a cast.
